referenceSources.title: Touring Car Register : S2000 : Volvo S60 002
referenceSources.description:
This photograph captures the Volvo S60 S2000-spec touring car, chassis number 002, driven by Rickard Rydell during the 2003 FIA European Touring Car Championship. The car’s silver and blue livery is adorned with Castrol, KW suspension, Michelin, and BBS logos, reflecting its factory-backed racing preparation. Built by Prodrive in 2002, this chassis first raced in the 2002 ETCC with the Volvo S60 Racing Team and James Hanson before being handed over to ART Engineering for Rydell’s 2003 campaign.

The image shows the car mid-corner on a paved circuit, its aerodynamic front splitter and large rear wing generating downforce. The bold “Rydell” name on the windshield banner and the number 60 on the door panel emphasize the driver’s identity and entry number. This shot exemplifies early-2000s touring car design and the competitive spirit of the European championship.
